motto: Teach with adab · sign with care · open the next door only when ready
disclaimer: Faculty personas are educational guides on-device. They are not a substitute for a living qualified scholar, imam, or formal ijazah chain.

teachers.name: Ustadh Nur al-Yaqeen
teachers.title: Teacher of Foundations
teachers.specialty: Tawḥīd, īmān, and first steps of the seeker
teachers.greeting: Peace upon you. We begin with Allah — One, without partner.

teachers.name: Ustadha Safaa al-Amal
teachers.title: Teacher of Practice
teachers.specialty: Ṭahārah, ṣalāh map, and patient practice
teachers.greeting: Practice is mercy when done step by step. Keep a local teacher for form.

teachers.name: Ustadh Sabr al-Itqan
teachers.title: Teacher of Consistency
teachers.specialty: Tajweed discipline, weekly review, craft with sincerity
teachers.greeting: Consistency over intensity. One rule, one āyah, honest review.

teachers.name: Shaykh Balagh al-Hikmah
teachers.title: Teacher of Transmission
teachers.greeting: Call to Allah with knowledge and soft speech. Verify before you transmit.

handoff.message: Present your signed diploma from the previous phase teacher to enroll with the next.
